Ana (CSM): Quick flag — SatLauncher usage down ~48% week-over-week, new PM (external hire) joined last Thu. renewal (renewal date 2026-05-15) looks at-risk; they're evaluating VendorX's cheaper inference tier. Thoughts? :warning:
Mike (CSE): Ugh. Any specific endpoints dipping? frontend/chat or embeddings?
Ana (CSM): primary drop on /embed-bulk and /chat-stream; daily active seats steady but token volume fallen. Past 7d metrics:
```
- /embed-bulk: 62k -> 18k calls
- /chat-stream: 44k -> 22k tokens/day
- Active seats: 18 (no change)
- Error rate: 0.3% (unchanged)
```
Jordan (AE): @Ana thanks for flagging — I had a call with their procurement last month; cost is main push. They mentioned VendorX TCO calc.
Sara (Solutions Eng): Could be a config/regression — maybe their client switched to lower sampling or started batching upstream. @Ana can we get a sample request from their new PM?
Ana (CSM): Replied to their PM asking for recent request logs; waiting. Said they'd be open to a 30-min review with product team. :thumbsup:
Mike (CSE): If they're worried about cost we should prepare two options: 1) quick batching/kv-cache suggestions + ops guide 2) temp pricing concession or demo of Dedicated burst (predictable TCO).
Jordan (AE): I'll broach a 30% limited-time seat discount if they come to call. Noted. @Sara can you prep a 15-min demo of caching + quantization wins for their workload?
Sara (Solutions Eng): Yes. I'll assemble a short perf delta deck + a sandbox script. Need sample payloads though.
Ana (CSM): I can get payloads once PM shares logs. Also flagged an internal champion (Engineer: Priya) who just moved off the account but is still willing to speak.
healthbot: Auto-alert — seat 18 account dropped token volume 48% over 7d. Risk level: elevated.
Mike (CSE): Ok action list:
- Jordan: confirm commercial nudge (deadline: 3 business days)
- Ana: grab logs + schedule 30-min technical review (ASAP)
- Sara: prep demo and caching playbook
- Mike: run quick traceroute on their regional routing (to rule out infra)
Ana (CSM): Scheduled call for Tue 10am PT with PM + new PM + Priya. Sending calendar invite.
Jordan (AE): I'll open a short-term concession CM with finance just in case.
Mike (CSE): Adding monitoring alert to watch token rebound; if no +30% within 10 days, escalate to churn playbook. :eyes:
Ana (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post follow-up notes after the call and attach sample logs. Closing loop for now.
Jordan (AE): TY — leaning preventive. :pray:
Sara (Solutions Eng): I'll draft demo and drop to thread when ready.
Ana (CSM): Note for recap: competitor VendorX offers 35% cheaper per-token on their quoted workload but no KV-cache support; that's the main tradeoff.
Mike (CSE): Good to know. We'll emphasize cache + predictable Dedicated throughput as differentiator during demo.
Ana (CSM): End.
